clips.title: The story
paras: At Regthar Deathgate's bunker west of the Crossroads, a torn banner marks the broken assault. Warlord Krom'zar led the Kolkar retaliatory force from Desolace.

Warlord Krom'zar led a warband east from Desolace to strike back. Kolkar chieftains across the Barrens had fallen, and the furious centaurs attacked the defensive bunkers west of the Crossroads. A strip cut from Krom'zar's fallen standard gives Regthar Deathgate proof that the assault was crushed and the southern trade routes were preserved for the Horde.
